notes: ForeverToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Forever Cult Fund (FOREVER), with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers deliver the full amount without fees or burns. There are no administrative privileges or external minting functions, and no application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
